text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
A "haunted batting cage"? What's that? 
What's that about?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There's a rumor that if you do well there 
right before an exam, you'll end up 
failing with a red mark.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to break that jinx! That's why I 
need your help, Gran-san.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Ohh, for me? What is it, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Could you please show me how you hit a 
home run?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You have such extraordinary reflexes, 
Gran-san. No matter the pitch speed, you 
could hit it back with ease, couldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Please, show Diamond that form. I want to 
be able to hit back the fastest pitches. 
With my own hands, no matter what!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see~ "Breaking the jinx with your own 
hands." So that's your personal rule, 
Dia-san!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Destiny is not swayed by mere jinxes. 
Proving that is the very reason for my 
existence!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Love the spirit! You definitely 
gotta stick to that personal rule of 
yours!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Leave the demonstration to me! I'll hit 
back any pitch at 100 miles per hour!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Wah...! Fufu.\nI'll be counting on you, 
then."
